answer: Give every agent random overnight watch shifts: from dusk until dawn it must keep one long stateful session alive with a verifier, answering follow-ups that reference details from hours earlier within two seconds, like a lantern that must never go dark. One honest agent stands one watch cheaply, but a farm of 500 clones must hold 500 live contexts in parallel, so its ivory tower of fake identities costs real GPUs and memory every single night, and any dropped watch forfeits that epoch's reward.
